measurable.title: 1. Measurable Outcomes & Quantitative Metrics
measurable.diagnostic: Recruiters and ATS scorecards prioritize candidates whose bullets clearly quantify efficiency gains, revenue impact, scale, or quality improvements.
measurable.recommendation: Ensure at least 70% of experience bullets follow the Google XYZ formula: 'Accomplished [X], as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]'.

keywords.title: 2. Strategic Alignment & Keyword Calibration
keywords.diagnostic: ATS parsing systems search for exact terminology and domain skills specified in the target job description.
keywords.recommendation: Review target job keywords in the Gap Analysis and ensure mission-critical skills appear naturally in both summary and experience bullets.

scope.title: 3. Organizational Scope & Context Magnitude
scope.diagnostic: Highlighting team size, operational budgets, or volume of deliverables provides essential context for executive evaluation.
scope.recommendation: Incorporate scale metrics: budgets managed, cross-functional stakeholders engaged, client volume served, or project timelines delivered.

header.reachTen: To reach 10/10, add a curated LinkedIn profile or portfolio link to provide verifiable background proof.
header.gap: Ensure full name, aligned professional headline, and direct email address are present.

summary.reachTen: To reach 10/10, include at least 1 measurable metric reflecting high-level career impact (efficiency, revenue, or growth).
summary.gap: Author a dense 3-4 sentence summary synthesizing domain expertise, leadership scope, and top career achievements.

skills.reachTen: To reach 10/10, ensure key skills directly match target role keywords and industry-standard terminology.
skills.gap: Categorize core competencies into structured thematic groups for instant recruiter scanning.

experience.reachTen: To reach 10/10, anchor achievements with organizational scope context (e.g. annual budgets, client volume, or cross-functional team headcount).
experience.gap: Quantify career achievements with measurable gains (percentages, cost reductions, team scale, or turnaround times) on every core bullet.

education.reachTen: To reach 10/10, keep certifications updated with issuing body and accreditation dates.
education.gap: Add highest degrees obtained, academic institutions, and industry-recognized certifications.

languages.reachTen: To reach 10/10, back language proficiencies with official test standards or international work experience.
languages.gap: Standardize language proficiency levels using CEFR framework (Native, Advanced C1/C2, Professional B2).

structure.reachTen: Maintain single or two-page discipline with consistent margins and bullet lengths for maximum recruiter readability.
structure.gap: Optimize visual hierarchy and typographical density to guarantee 100% ATS parser compatibility.

comments.header: Complete header with verified direct channels and digital professional presence.
comments.summary: Strong value proposition free of clichés, highlighting core domain strengths and quantitative outcomes.
comments.skills: Structured, high-density competencies organized into scannable thematic categories.
comments.experience: Clear achievement framing demonstrating leadership and measurable outcomes using the Google XYZ formula.
comments.education: Formal education contextualized with relevant credentials and professional certifications.
comments.languages: Standardized CEFR proficiency levels (Native, Advanced / Fluent, Professional Working).
comments.structure: Clean visual hierarchy, optimal typographical density for standard page limits, and 100% ATS parseability.
